title: Episode 21
logline: After defying her own despair to cure a fever-stricken village boy with her mother's herbal remedies, Lady Juliana learns that the Dowager Duchess is secretly withering away from a mysterious illness inside Ashbury Manor.
continuity_notes: Directly follows Episode 20's cliffhanger where Catherine and Rupert plotted to seize Ashbury upon the Dowager Duchess's demise; in the village, Juliana puts aside her grief over her burned cottage to save young Toby, stumbling upon critical intelligence regarding the manor.

blocks.camera:

blocks.speaker: PRUDENCE (Anguished, Resentful):
blocks.text:
Start: (00:18.20) | End: (00:21.70)
"He shut the door in my face because we have no silver!"

blocks.camera:

blocks.speaker: LADY JULIANA (Sorrowful, Dejected):
blocks.text:

"We have no clinic now."

blocks.text:

"Our cottage is ashes. I have nothing left but this coltsfoot."

Start: (00:31.00) | End: (00:33.00)
Prudence drops desperately to her knees onto the hay-strewn barn floor, clasping her hands in tearful supplication.

Prudence drops desperately to her knees onto the hay-strewn barn floor, clasping her hands in tearful supplication.

blocks.speaker: PRUDENCE (Pleading, Desperate):
blocks.text:

"He is only seven! If you do not come, he will die! You are his only hope, Lady Juliana!"

blocks.speaker: LADY JULIANA (Resolute, Authoritative):
blocks.text:

"Stand up. Sinking to your knees will not save him. Let me grab my ledger. We go now."

blocks.speaker: LADY JULIANA (Instructive, Calm):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:01.00) | End: (01:04.00)
"Lift his shoulders, Prudence. Hold the steam close. Let him inhale."

Start: (01:04.50) | End: (01:06.80)
Close-up of Prudence supporting Toby's head, whispering tenderly into his ear.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:04.50) | End: (01:06.80)
Close-up of Prudence supporting Toby's head, whispering tenderly into his ear.

blocks.speaker: PRUDENCE (Tearful, Coaxing):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:04.50) | End: (01:06.60)
"Like this? Toby, breathe it in, sweet boy."

Start: (01:06.80) | End: (01:10.50)
Close-up of Lady Juliana gently waving her hand to direct the medicinal steam toward Toby's nose and mouth.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:06.80) | End: (01:10.50)
Close-up of Lady Juliana gently waving her hand to direct the medicinal steam toward Toby's nose and mouth.

blocks.speaker: LADY JULIANA (Encouraging, Reassuring):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:06.80) | End: (01:10.40)
"Yes, just like that. Keep breathing, Toby. Let the vapor clear your chest."

Start: (01:10.50) | End: (01:13.50)
Toby's strained wheezing eases into quiet, rhythmic breathing as he slips into peaceful sleep on his pillow.
blocks.action:
Start: (01:10.50) | End: (01:13.50)
Toby's strained wheezing eases into quiet, rhythmic breathing as he slips into peaceful sleep on his pillow.

Close-up of Toby's face relaxing, his chest falling still and calm.

blocks.text:
Start: (01:12.00) | End: (01:16.00)

Start: (01:12.00) | End: (01:16.00)
Close-up of Prudence covering her mouth in overwhelmed relief, tears streaming down her face.

blocks.speaker: PRUDENCE (Overwhelmed, Relieved):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:12.00) | End: (01:15.50)
"Oh, thank God! His chest is quiet! The rattling has stopped!"

Start: (01:15.50) | End: (01:19.50)
Lady Juliana pulls the plaid wool blanket snug over Toby's chest, smiling softly with profound relief.
blocks.action:

Lady Juliana pulls the plaid wool blanket snug over Toby's chest, smiling softly with profound relief.

blocks.text:

Medium shot of Lady Juliana sitting on a stool beside Toby's bedside, placing a cup of coltsfoot tea on a small wooden table.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:16.00) | End: (01:19.80)
Medium shot of Lady Juliana sitting on a stool beside Toby's bedside, placing a cup of coltsfoot tea on a small wooden table.

blocks.speaker: LADY JULIANA (Gentle, Caring):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:16.00) | End: (01:19.60)
"Keep him warm. Give him three drops of this coltsfoot tea every morning."

Start: (01:19.80) | End: (01:27.50)
Medium close-up of Prudence looking at Lady Juliana with awe and boundless gratitude, her hands clasped in front of her.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:19.80) | End: (01:27.50)
Medium close-up of Prudence looking at Lady Juliana with awe and boundless gratitude, her hands clasped in front of her.

blocks.speaker: PRUDENCE (Grateful, Choked with Emotion):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:19.80) | End: (01:23.00)
"You saved him. The grand doctors left him to choke, but you..."

blocks.speaker: PRUDENCE (Fervent, Devoted):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:23.00) | End: (01:27.50)
"I have no money, Lady Juliana, but I swear on my life, I will do anything to repay you."

Start: (01:27.50) | End: (01:30.80)
Lady Juliana takes Prudence's trembling hands into hers, smiling with heartfelt warmth.
blocks.action:
Start: (01:27.50) | End: (01:30.80)
Lady Juliana takes Prudence's trembling hands into hers, smiling with heartfelt warmth.

blocks.text:
Start: (01:27.50) | End: (01:31.00)
Close-up of Lady Juliana comforting Prudence warmly.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:27.50) | End: (01:31.00)
Close-up of Lady Juliana comforting Prudence warmly.

blocks.speaker: LADY JULIANA (Warm, Sincere):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:27.70) | End: (01:30.50)
"Your brother's breath is payment enough for me, Prudence."

Start: (01:31.00) | End: (01:36.50)
Low-angle shot past sleeping Toby toward Prudence standing in the room, her expression darkening with anger.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:31.00) | End: (01:36.50)
Low-angle shot past sleeping Toby toward Prudence standing in the room, her expression darkening with anger.

blocks.speaker: PRUDENCE (Indignant, Resentful):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:31.00) | End: (01:34.50)
"At the grand manor, they ignore us. They only care about their own luxury."

blocks.speaker: PRUDENCE (Ominous):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:34.60) | End: (01:36.40)
"But their gold cannot buy them health."

Start: (01:36.50) | End: (01:38.20)
Lady Juliana turns sharply, her eyes widening with sudden recognition.
blocks.action:
Start: (01:36.50) | End: (01:38.20)
Lady Juliana turns sharply, her eyes widening with sudden recognition.

blocks.text:
Start: (01:36.50) | End: (01:39.20)
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking directly into Prudence's eyes with startled concern.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:36.50) | End: (01:39.20)
Close-up of Lady Juliana looking directly into Prudence's eyes with startled concern.

blocks.speaker: LADY JULIANA (Startled, Curious):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:36.50) | End: (01:39.20)
"What do you mean? Is someone ill? The Dowager Duchess?"

Start: (01:39.20) | End: (01:41.20)
Low-angle cut to Toby sleeping peacefully as the fire crackles behind him.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:39.20) | End: (01:41.20)
Low-angle cut to Toby sleeping peacefully as the fire crackles behind him.

blocks.speaker: PRUDENCE (Solemn, O.S.):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:39.20) | End: (01:41.20)
"She is dying, Lady Juliana."

Start: (01:41.20) | End: (01:46.80)
Close-up of Prudence leaning in close to Lady Juliana, whispering with grave intensity.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:41.20) | End: (01:46.80)
Close-up of Prudence leaning in close to Lady Juliana, whispering with grave intensity.

blocks.speaker: PRUDENCE (Conspiratorial, Grim):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:41.20) | End: (01:43.40)
"A strange, mysterious illness is eating her away."

blocks.speaker: PRUDENCE (Dark, Chilling):
blocks.text:
Start: (01:43.50) | End: (01:48.40)
"Inside that massive house with all their wealth, she is fading to nothing, and no one can stop it."

Start: (01:46.80) | End: (01:48.50)
Brief cut back to Toby sleeping peacefully on his straw pillow by the warm fireplace.
blocks.camera:
Start: (01:46.80) | End: (01:48.50)
Brief cut back to Toby sleeping peacefully on his straw pillow by the warm fireplace.
